trim.title: Trim video – {0}
trim.hint: Move the sliders to the first and the last moment you want to keep.
pages.title: Arrange pages – {0}
pages.hint: Drag pages into a new order. Turn, copy or remove pages with the buttons under each page.

shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.empty: The shelf is empty. Drop files here, or turn on "results go to the shelf" in the settings.
shelf.hint: Drag files out of the shelf to use them elsewhere.
welcome.title: Welcome to Mo Converter
welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.subheading: Convert, compress and edit files without leaving the folder.
welcome.keys: Drag files and hold {0} for the convert wheel, {1} for tools, or {2} for actions. Then drop the files on a choice.
welcome.step1: 1. Start dragging one or more files in Explorer.
welcome.step2: 2. Hold the key of the wheel you want while you drag.
welcome.step3: 3. Move onto a choice and let go. Results appear next to your files.
welcome.step4: Tip: the tray icon next to the clock has the shelf, the QR code tool and this guide.
